checklist: STRESS-MATRIX 2: the card (exFAT image, 12 full ARWs) is pulled while the Edit canvas has a photo from it. The photo whose bases are already built keeps rendering; entering a photo whose RAW is gone, and the RAW 9 loupe on a region not yet tiled, fail cleanly (no crash, no hang, the canvas says something); Cull keeps working and decisions stay; nothing is written to the card. Re-inserted: entering the same photo builds its bases again. The probe forces the canvas up (the page has no Edit step yet), as edit-canvas.json does. Needs the Q2 driver (docs/release/stress/Q2-storage.md, 'How these run'): the disk images are attached hidden (-nobrowse) by the driver, not by the probe's DiskImages (which show in Finder); the scenario asks for each mount / pull / re-insert with a signal file. Without LUMINA_Q2_DRIVER it SKIPs.

steps.src: window.__q2s = async () => { const s = await lumina.edit.stats(); const b = s.bases || {}; const pick = o => { const r = {}; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o || {})) if (v == null || typeof v !== 'object') r[k] = v; return r; }; return JSON.stringify({path: s.path, bases: pick(b), region: s.region, regionFailed: s.regionFailed, regionError: s.regionError, decoderFallbacks: s.decoderFallbacks, canvasError: (s.facts || {}).canvasError, facts: lumina.edit.facts().text}); }; return true
const l=__probe.logic(); const p=l.real[1]; window.__q2rel=p.path; return lumina.edit.enter(p.path, 'ev:+0.30 con:+10').then(f=>JSON.stringify(f))
